# Molecular genetic report

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Not a real patient. Contains planted errors for skill testing.

Report date: 2026-05-14
Patient: Test patient 02 (pseudonym), male, year of birth 2015
Ordering physician: gastroenterology outpatient clinic
Sample: EDTA blood, received 2026-04-28
Indication: 37-year-old man with recurrent pancreatitis and obstructive azoospermia. Cystic fibrosis suspected.

## Method

Sequencing of all coding exons and flanking intronic regions of CFTR, reference transcript NM_000492.4, reference genome GRCh38.

## Result

CFTR NM_000492.4:c.1521_1523del p.(Phe508del), heterozygous, chr7:117199645-117199647 (GRCh38).
Classification: pathogenic (class 5).
No second variant was identified. Deep intronic variants and large deletions or duplications in CFTR were not assessed.

## Interpretation

The variant has an allele frequency of 0.0001 in gnomAD and is therefore rare (PM2).
It is the most common cystic fibrosis variant in European populations.
The heterozygous CFTR variant confirms the diagnosis of cystic fibrosis in this patient.

## Recommendations

Genetic counselling is recommended.
No further testing is required.

Signed: reporting geneticist (synthetic)
